short_description:
How to fast travel in GTA 6: there's no map menu for it. Call a Paradise Taxi (open right after the first mission) or, later, book a ride on the RydeMe phone app, then pay to skip the trip: guides say the skip costs $100 on top of the fare, and RydeMe takes it from your BuckMe bank account. Guides differ on when RydeMe unlocks (Chapter 1 or 2). No story spoilers.

Sources: GTABase, Dotesports, BGR, GamerFuzion.

More GTA 6 how-tos at vicereplay.com (Guides).
